different workload from the product rather than an environment of it, and

No region keys: the region is decided in

_delegationComment: The role in the management account (855289196875) that may write this
zone's NS record into the kgwari.com apex. Scoped to NS records for named
children only — it cannot touch the apex A records or the Workspace MX
read by scripts/aws/bootstrap-account.mjs so the delegation is not a paste
job. `kgwari-web` must be a trusted principal on it and `portfolio.kgwari.com`
one of its permitted record names, or the delegation step fails AccessDenied.
